lead.en: This page states plainly what an AI assistant did on this site, and where no AI is present at all.

text.en: The site was specified and built with the help of an AI coding assistant, working from the founder's texts. Statements of fact come from supplied material or from public pages checked on the dates shown. Nothing on the site is generated at visit time, and the site has no chatbot.

items.en: SelfAI is a concept. No model or service exists.
The Ontology AI Agent is described by the Ontology Department as trained on first principles and allowed to say "I do not know yet". Its behaviour is not evaluated here.

body.en: A person remains responsible for what is published. Mistakes can be reported as corrections.

text.en: No claim on this site is generated at visit time.
